parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
Language type for request and response messages. Values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: User ID for administrators to switch to other member's perspective.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
View type.

- **0**: Current Alibaba Cloud account view.
- **1**: View for all accounts under the enterprise.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sophonsoar describe-process-task-count --entity-uuid-list a680c9ae-0000-4c39-0000-03020000fc8e --lang zh --role-type 0 --role-for 104739000000259 --api-version 2022-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
